My dear [Lucy](/person/2116)
If I can get a lift I shall be very glad to come to you, but it must rather depend on the ‘other house.’ Does [George](/person/1611) know that we have the [Bishop Selwyn](/person/1296), his [mother](/person/1297), children and [new wife](/person/1685) at the Vicarage for a month? [^1]
Your affectionate cousin

C M Yonge


[^1]: The Rt. Rev. John Richardson Selwyn (1844-1898), who became Bishop of Melanesia in 1877 and retired to England finally in September 1891. This letter may date however from his previous visit to England in June 1889-January 1890. He had married his second wife Annie Catherine (Mort) Selwyn in 1885.
